journey.name: Payment Request Expiry Toast
journey.description: Verifies that a pending incoming one-time Payment Request that expires unopened shows the expired toast once, and that a request the user opened is not reported twice. Uses the linked fixture issuer from README.md, which can send a request with a short proposal expiry. Toasts do not reach the layout dump, so capture a screenshot right after the expiry.

actions.action: Launch the E2E Bitkit app with Paykit UI enabled and the fixture issuer saved as a contact and linked
Have the issuer send a proposed one-time request for 0.001 btc with a proposal expiry 60 seconds from now
Dismiss the automatic Payment Request confirmation with Back and stay on the home screen without opening the request
Verify the pending Payment Requests bell (testTag "PaymentRequestsBell") is visible
Wait until the proposal expiry passes
Verify from a screenshot that a toast titled "Payment Request" with "The payment request has expired." appears, and that the bell (testTag "PaymentRequestsBell") is gone
Verify no second expired toast appears within the next 10 seconds
Have the issuer send another one-time request with a proposal expiry 60 seconds from now, dismiss the automatic confirmation, then tap the bell and open the request row to its details
Wait on Payment Request details until the expiry passes and verify at most one expired toast appears
